briefTitle: Study of the Immune Response of MUC1 (Mucin1) Peptide Vaccine for Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Women and men at least 18 years of age
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Women and men at least 18 years of age

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects must have histologically or cytologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) or neuroendocrine carcinoid tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Includes neuroendocrine carcinoid tumor alongside NSCLC, making a straightforward histology classification complex.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have stable disease at the time of enrollment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Stable disease is a clinical/imaging assessment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects must be within 4 to 24 weeks of standard of care treatment for their particular stage of disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires a complex window relative to prior standard of care treatment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Creatinine within normal institutional limits OR Creatinine clearance > 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 for subjects with above normal AST and ALT with alkaline phosphatase within < 1.5 times upper limit of normal
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Conditional creatinine clearance based on AST and ALT levels cannot be represented purely by simple cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects may not be receiving any other investigational agents
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concurrent treatment restriction is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No history of prior malignancy, except for non-melanoma skin cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior malignancy exclusion with exception is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any positive ANA titer above 1:160, even in an asymptomatic individual.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Lab titer cutoff with clinical exceptions is not a standard typed lab.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known Hepatitis B on immunomodulators (i.e. interferon)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Conditional infection exclusion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known Hepatitis C on immunomodulators (i.e. interferon)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Conditional infection exclusion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients may not be receiving any steroids or other anti-immune therapy at the time of registration.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medication exclusion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects must not be more than 24 weeks from standard of care treatment for their particular stage of disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion window based on prior standard of care treatment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects must not have post-obstructive pneumonia or other serious infection at the time of registration or other serious underlying medical condition that would impair the ability of the subjects to receive protocol treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex investigator discretion and medical condition exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior resection of lung cancer is allowed, if at least five years have elapsed between previous resection and registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Conditional prior resection timeline is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, or psychiatric illness/social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled illness and psychiatric/social situation evaluation is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pregnant women are excluded from this study. Women of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy testing and status are standard clinical exclusions not mapped to typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with immune deficiency are not expected to respond to the vaccine. Therefore, known HIV-positive patients are excluded from the study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV status exclusion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with a history of known autoimmune disease are excluded from this study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease history exclusion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have stable disease at the time of enrollment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Disease stability is a clinical or radiological assessment, not a typed lab or staging check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects must be within 4 to 24 weeks of standard of care treatment for their particular stage of disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout or prior treatment window relative to standard of care is not a simple typed prior therapy or interval rule.
